text: i dont see that log tbh. i restarted and everything but i just see r3d-census and ground-pass but no paintdiag
resolution: The [paintdiag] console.log never reached the user's terminal — cart console.log isn't routed there (only Zig logs like r3d-census/ground-pass are). Replaced it with an on-screen readout: a bottom-left overlay shown in paint mode displaying faces/noUV/fullSquare/overlap/maxUV/repack/tex, so the user can read the live model's UV layout directly. This unblocks diagnosing req_1376 (the one-click-paints-4-faces bleed): overlap>0 or fullSquare>0 means faces share atlas islands. Cart-only, hot-reloads.
